title: Your name in the PDF Author field on Mac (hide it for double-blind review in LaTeX)
short_title: Blinded your paper? Your name may still be in the PDF properties

runs.cmd: cd "$(mktemp -d)" && printf '%s\n' '\documentclass{article}' '\usepackage[pdfusetitle]{hyperref}' '\title{Trust in Phishing Warnings}' '\author{Jane Smith}' '\begin{document}' '\maketitle' 'Text.' '\end{document}' > paper.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode paper.tex >/dev/null && /opt/homebrew/bin/exiftool -S -Author paper.pdf

cd "$(mktemp -d)" && printf '%s\n' '\documentclass{article}' '\usepackage[pdfusetitle]{hyperref}' '\title{Trust in Phishing Warnings}' '\author{Jane Smith}' '\hypersetup{pdfauthor={}}' '\begin{document}' '\maketitle' 'Text.' '\end{document}' > paper.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode paper.tex >/dev/null && /opt/homebrew/bin/exiftool -S -Author paper.pdf

cd "$(mktemp -d)" && printf '%s\n' '\documentclass{article}' '\usepackage[pdfusetitle]{hyperref}' '\title{Trust in Phishing Warnings}' '\author{Jane Smith}' '\hypersetup{pdfauthor={Anonymous}}' '\begin{document}' '\maketitle' 'Text.' '\end{document}' > paper.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode paper.tex >/dev/null && /opt/homebrew/bin/exiftool -S -Author paper.pdf

verify.notes: Run 2026-10-30 on the Mac mini with TinyTeX pdflatex (TeX Live) and Homebrew exiftool 13.55, in a fresh mktemp folder. A minimal article with \usepackage[pdfusetitle]{hyperref} and \author{Jane Smith} writes Jane Smith into the PDF Author field. Setting \hypersetup{pdfauthor={}} does not clear it (pdfusetitle refills an empty pdfauthor from \author), so the video does not suggest it; \hypersetup{pdfauthor={Anonymous}} before \begin{document} does. Removing the pdfusetitle option also left Author empty in a separate run. The on-screen command drops the full /opt/homebrew/bin path. The hyperref manual on CTAN documents pdfusetitle and pdfauthor; exiftool.org documents exiftool. The Paper Review page states the free check looks for anonymity leftovers and every tier runs an anonymity scan for double-blind submission (author names, institutions, funders, protocol numbers and self-citations left in the text); the app scene claims only that.

scenes.title: Your name is still in the PDF
scenes.sub: Not on the page. In the file's properties.
scenes.narration: You took your name off the title page for a double-blind review. But the PDF itself can still list you as the author, in its properties, where any reviewer can look.

scenes.label: Terminal
scenes.narration: Here is a paper built with LaTeX. Exiftool reads the file's Author field, and it still says Jane Smith.

scenes.text: The hyperref option pdfusetitle copies your \author line into the PDF Author field.
scenes.narration: Many templates load hyperref with the option p d f use title. It copies your author line into the PDF's properties. Setting the author to an empty value does not help, because the option fills an empty field again.

scenes.label: In your .tex file
scenes.ui: Add the first line just above \begin{document}, then rebuild. Removing pdfusetitle also works.
scenes.narration: In your main tex file, add hypersetup with p d f author set to Anonymous, before begin document. Then rebuild the PDF. Removing the p d f use title option works too.

scenes.label: Terminal
scenes.narration: Run exiftool again. The Author field now says Anonymous. Check the file name too, before you upload.

scenes.name: Paper Review
scenes.line: A free check looks for anonymity leftovers. Every review scans for names, institutions and self-citations left in the text.
scenes.narration: Before a double-blind submission, Paper Review's free check looks for anonymity leftovers in your manuscript. Every paid review also scans for author names, institutions, funders and self-citations left in the text.
